sloka: उपागम्य च मे देवो महादेवः सुर ईश्वरः ।सर्वान् लोकान् जितान् आह मम पुण्येन कर्मणा ॥३-७-११॥
transliteration: upāgamya ca me devo mahādevaḥ sura īśvaraḥ ।sarvān lokān jitān āha mama puṇyena karmaṇā ॥3-7-11॥

translations.english: O scion of the Kakutstha family, Indra, king of the gods came to me and said that by my meritorious deeds I have won all the worlds.
